stepBody: See image. Only type what is in the blank, do not include what is provided. Do not use spaces unless absolutely necessary. Please use double quotes (" "), instead of single quotes (' '). If you are utilizing the table, please use the numbers in order.##figure4.gif##

figureAlts.figure4.gif: (a) Find the name of the pokemon with highest HP among type Water pokemon. The code snippet has several blanks to fill in. The first line assigns water_pokemon to a filtered version of pokemon, with three blanks labeled Blank 1, Blank 2, and Blank 3. The second line uses water_pokemon with three more blanks labeled Blank 4, Blank 5, and Blank 6, followed by .column("Name").item(0).
